# Payerkart

> Payerkart is a healthcare payer infrastructure API for hospitals. It delivers insurance eligibility verification and claim status tracking into the hospital's EHR through one API and one schema, backed by an established clearinghouse connection. Live in production: at one practice it cut a ~15-minute payer-portal eligibility check to under a second. A product of Blue Matrix Connect.

Scope: eligibility verification and claim status tracking only. Payerkart does not submit claims and is not a clearinghouse.

## Product
- [Eligibility verification](https://payerkart.com/eligibility-verification.html): Real-time and overnight batch eligibility; coverage, plan dates, copay, deductible, network status, coverage by service.
- [Claim status tracking](https://payerkart.com/claim-status.html): Poll or webhook on adjudication changes; plain-language denial reasons; remittance detail.
- [EHR integration](https://payerkart.com/ehr-integration.html): Standard adapter contract; eClinicalWorks was the first adapter.
- [For hospitals](https://payerkart.com/for-hospitals.html): What changes for patient access, billing and IT teams.
- [Payer coverage](https://payerkart.com/payer-coverage.html): Commercial and government payers across the US via clearinghouse connectivity.

## Developers
- [API docs](https://payerkart.com/docs.html): Base URL https://api.payerkart.com/v1, Bearer auth, POST /v1/eligibility, GET /v1/claims/:id, webhooks, errors, sandbox.

## Trust
- [Security & compliance](https://payerkart.com/security.html): Encryption in transit and at rest, scoped keys, role-based access, audit logs, BAA available.
- [Case study](https://payerkart.com/case-study-eligibility-15-minutes-to-under-a-second.html): 15 minutes to under a second per eligibility check.
